title: Appointment of Chief Justices of High Courts as Judges of the Supreme Court of India
body_text:
In exercise of the powers conferred by the Constitution of India, the President of India is pleased to appoint the following Chief Justices of High Courts as Judges of the Supreme Court of India:
Smt. Justice Sunita Agarwal, Chief Justice, Gujarat High Court (PHC: Allahabad) Shri Justice Devendra Kumar Upadhyaya Chief Justice, Delhi High Court (PHC: Allahabad) Shri Justice Aparesh Kumar Singh, Chief Justice, Telangana High Court (PHC: Jharkhand)
**
